Overview

Capable AMD Ryzen 5 Performance

Powered by the AMD Ryzen 5 processor with 4 cores and 8 threads, this Lenovo 15 15.6-inch Windows Laptop delivers responsive performance for everyday computing and multitasking needs. Consequently, users can work, browse, and manage multiple applications with ease.


High-Speed 16GB Memory

Incorporating 16GB of LPDDR5-5500 memory, this Windows laptop is designed to support smooth multitasking and efficient application handling. Moreover, switching between tasks remains responsive throughout the day.


Rapid 512GB SSD Storage

Featuring a 512GB M.2 PCIe 4.0 NVMe SSD, this laptop offers fast data access and ample space for essential files and applications. Thus, boot times, file transfers, and software loading can be completed more quickly.


Refined Full HD Visuals

Featuring a 15.6-inch Full HD display with a 1920 x 1080 resolution, this Windows laptop provides clear and detailed visuals for daily use. Therefore, documents, videos, and online content appear sharp and easy to view.


Integrated Radeon Graphics

Powered by integrated AMD Radeon 610M Graphics, this 15.6-inch laptop delivers dependable visual performance for everyday productivity and entertainment. Consequently, users can enjoy smooth graphics rendering for routine computing tasks.


Anti-Glare Viewing Experience

Equipped with an anti-glare display panel, this laptop helps minimise distracting reflections in brightly lit environments. As a result, users can enjoy more comfortable viewing during extended sessions.


Immersive Dolby Audio Sound

Equipped with user-facing stereo speakers optimised with Dolby Audio, this Windows laptop enhances the listening experience with clear and balanced sound output. Furthermore, movies, music, and online meetings benefit from improved audio quality.


Secure HD Camera Convenience

Featuring an HD 720p camera with a privacy shutter, this laptop supports video calls while providing additional privacy when the camera is not in use. Therefore, users can participate in virtual meetings with confidence.


Practical Backlit Keyboard Design

Incorporating a backlit keyboard, this Lenovo laptop enables comfortable typing even in dimly lit environments. Additionally, the illuminated keys improve visibility and convenience during late-night work sessions.
